title: Windows Was The Problem All Along
summary: Dave2D reviews the Lenovo Legion Go S running Valve's SteamOS instead of Windows, calling it the first true competitor to the Steam Deck. He compares handheld gaming performance and experience across the two operating systems.
why: HN commenters cite it as reviewer evidence that games run faster and with better battery life on Linux/SteamOS than on Windows on identical hardware.

quote.text: It’s not just that the games run faster but that battery life is also better.
